title: Close PR, branch, documentation and foundation handoff gates
goal: Reach the maintainer's main-only, all-checks-green final acceptance state and record the release decision.

in: release notes and foundation handoff records
out: Publishing or deleting branches before human release gate

acceptanceCriteria: All in-scope PRs are merged and no PR remains open under the maintainer's stated closeout criterion; exact PR URLs and merge SHAs are recorded.
Only main remains in the required local/remote branch scope, after authorized branch cleanup; no destructive cleanup is performed during planning.
The exact main SHA has all required CI and Release Gate checks green, Sonar accepted, docs accurate, and no unresolved release Blocker.
Maintainer performs final visual/functional acceptance and separately authorizes immutable release/publication and pantheon-ops consumer lock update.

runtimeEvidence: PR/branch state snapshot and final gate URLs
release SHA/tag and Ops handoff decision
